concepts.title: A · 星环守望
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: professional game landmark concept design board for the existing Chinese campus social game 创智小镇. Preview only, not a screenshot or interface implementation.
Input images: image 1 is the established dragon mascot identity reference (branching blue antlers, white face, blue cloud mane, big blue eyes, curled tail with warm orange flame). Image 2 is the current classic daytime town environment reference; image 3 is the same town at night. Image 4 is the pixel edition reference.
Preserve the dragon identity and established cheerful clean blue-white palette. Reinterpret the mascot as a thoughtfully designed ROBOT SCULPTURE / knowledge guardian landmark that feels omniscient, quietly powerful, welcoming and intelligent. Characteristic antlers, face and cloud mane must read unmistakably as the same dragon species. No hoodie or backpack on the sculpture.
Art direction: polished 2.5D game environment concept art, very clear silhouettes, economical mechanical segmentation, crafted enamel/ceramic and brushed metal, soft clean hand-painted lighting matching the classic town. Rich but controlled blues with warm cream and restrained gold accents. No dirty paper grain, no grunge, no random microdetail, no cheap toy render, no photorealism, no god rays, no grandiose dark-fantasy deity, no icon soup or random decoration.
Design board layout: landscape 3:2, beautiful warm ivory art-director presentation sheet, generous margins. About 60% left dedicated to one LARGE beautifully resolved 3/4 hero view of the design on its small circular base, isolated against ivory, full silhouette visible. On the right, two stacked rectangular in-context crops showing exactly this design at the BACK CENTER rim of the existing sunken circular plaza, day above and night below. The landmark is about 2.3 resident heights, a small footprint occupying no more than 15% of the plaza width, plenty of open walkable plaza. Place one SMALL standard blue-white dragon resident nearby in each inset to communicate scale. Keep the gazebo, lake, stone steps and soft green trees from the environment recognizable. At lower left beside the hero, a small very readable actual pixel-art translation of the SAME design (limited palette, crisp clusters, consistent with image 4), not a separate idea.
Only restrained top-left typographic label specified below; no explanatory text, fake UI, arrows, watermarks, extra logos or giant signage. Primary rendering should be crafted and art directed; prioritize iconic silhouette over decorative effects.
Text (verbatim): "A · 星环守望".
Design A: the strongest ROBOT / divine guardian interpretation. A compact white ceramic dragon robot with soft cobalt metal joint recesses, a white dragon face with brilliant blue lens eyes and subtle visor edge, translucent azure antlers, blue cloud mane formed from 5 clean interlocking ceramic modules. A single thin warm-metal astronomical ring sits vertically behind the head and shoulders, NOT a crown, with 3 modest blue light nodes. Robot levitates a hand's breadth above a low warm stone plinth, clear soft contact shadow. Relaxed symmetrical arms, palms gently opened; an inset blue knowledge core glows softly in its chest. One curled white segmented tail ending in a small warm amber flame-shaped crystal. Calm smile, centered poised body, sculptural dignity. A subtle blue circular inlay at the base. Make it a visually memorable helpful town oracle rather than a generic armored action figure. Day: enamel white + clean cobalt, minimal glow. Night: gentle blue halo, amber tail, light pooling on nearby stone, surrounding town still visible. Hero is in daylight.

Design B: a genuinely distinct SEATED civic sculpture with quiet character. A white stone-and-porcelain mechanical dragon sits sideways on one closed cobalt-blue monumental book, one foot resting lower, posture relaxed and attentive. It holds an open sculptural book over its lap, with thin warm-metal page edges and an understated luminous star-map on the facing pages. Sculpted cloud-shaped mane, recognizable branching blue antlers, round gentle blue eyes looking slightly toward a visitor. Body is carefully articulated porcelain plates with a few visible brass pivot joints; white torso and cobalt lower limbs, no human clothing. Tail curls along the book base and terminates in an amber flame lamp. Low oval warm-stone foundation, a small inviting vacant stone seat integrated beside it, coherent scale. One simple circular brass arc tucked behind shoulders evokes an astrolabe. The book and readable seated silhouette define this design, not levitation. Day: warm approachable landmark, subtly scholarly. Night: open book softly lights face and visitor seat, amber tail lamp, blue antler edge glow. No piles of books, no scattered props. Hero is in daylight.

Design C: an architectural mechanical ARMILLARY SCULPTURE rather than a standing mascot. A recognizable blue-white mechanical dragon curls gracefully in a C shape around a small suspended azure celestial globe, one rounded paw supporting the globe and the other resting on the low stone drum base. Dragon face appears clearly in the upper right of the sculpture, with white muzzle, blue lens eyes, branching blue antlers and cloud mane; relaxed intelligent gaze toward viewer. Its cobalt and porcelain articulated body/tail form one sweeping sculptural crescent around the globe, tail tip a tiny warm amber flame. TWO thin brushed brass orbital arcs passing behind globe complete a clean airy almost circular silhouette, generous negative space, no excessive rings. The glassy globe has 5 tiny star nodes connected by precise fine lines; no text inside. Warm-stone plinth with a slim blue inset ring and accessible low edge. This is an iconic shared town knowledge source with the same dragon identity, not a generic atom sculpture or desktop crystal ball. Day: translucent luminous blue globe but natural sunlight; night: star nodes and globe create a beautiful gentle central beacon, warm town lights still dominate the environment. Hero is in daylight.
